meaning: A single schema profile explicitly supplies a God from whom Jesus holds a mandate, actual Catholic founding and visibility, and a distinct other society actually founded by Jesus and visible. Attestation, veracity, Catholic-only scope including teaching and envoy transfer hold, but divine teaching-founding fails at that same God/other-body pair and the universal bridge fails. Universal mandate scope and stage6 identity also fail. This exports nonvacuous Catholic scope and the precise other-body countercase, not merely global nonemptiness or hidden properties of a concrete construction.
